# Report — 2026-09-29, 14:37 ET

**T2 decisions: none.** `python pipeline/due.py t2-list` returned nothing. MU was gated by code earlier today and frozen INELIGIBLE (`thin_oi`), so no decision was due; no other pilot event has a snapshot session of 2026-09-29. This step gated nothing and froze nothing.

**Freeze commits: none from this run.** Today's freeze already happened in the earlier run — `6da4a56`, MU 2026-09-30, INELIGIBLE, **BLIND** (committed 14:31:08 ET against a 2026-09-30 09:30 ET entry open). This was the second fire of the same ET day; the first ran 14:31–14:35 ET.

**PENDING changes: none. AEHR stays PENDING.**
- aehr.com/newsroom (HTTP 200): newest item still 2026-09-28, the CEO Investor Summit release — an investor conference, not an earnings date. Newest financial-results item is still 2026-07-14.
- SEC EDGAR (CIK 0001040470) as the second company source: newest filings ARS 2026-09-10 and DEF 14A 2026-09-09, annual-meeting material. No 8-K carrying a date.
- yfinance unchanged at 2026-11-02 15:00 ET (intraday, and outside the pilot window). Nasdaq unchanged at 2026-10-05 `time-not-supplied`; AEHR is on no Oct 1, Oct 6 or Oct 7 row.
- AEHR's own ~7-day lead implied an announcement on Sep 28. It did not come. Its earliest possible snapshot session is **2026-10-01** — one housekeeping run left before code marks it INELIGIBLE `unconfirmed`. Expect that.

**Nothing went wrong.** `check.py` PASS before and after. Health check, re-check and STATE.md log committed as `3df2ac6` and pushed to `origin/main`.

**One thing worth saying plainly:** running two fires per ET day means the second one repeats the first one's PENDING re-check verbatim — this one re-checked AEHR two minutes after the last check. It costs almost nothing, but the re-check list is filling with repetition. Worth collapsing to one PENDING re-check per ET day next time the workflow is edited from a laptop session; this step may not touch `.github/`. Noted in STATE.md.

**Next:** NKE's snapshot session is tomorrow (Wed Sep 30, AMC Oct 1) — the first pilot event that can actually reach a T2 decision.
